messages.subject: Re: ETA question from a customer of ours
messages.body:
Hi Walt 😊

No pest at all, always happy to hear from you.

What you're describing sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: the ETA recalculates when a driver's route changes (traffic, a new stop inserted, a failed delivery attempt pushing everything back). It can look jumpy when several stops are clustered, because one delay ripples through the afternoon.

If you tell me the tracking numbers and rough times, I'll pull the route logs and confirm nothing unusual happened. And if it turns out to be something on our side, I'll chase it properly.

Warm regards,
Aisha Bello
Head of Customer Success, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: Re: Billing portal session timeouts
messages.body:
Hi Carla 😊

Lena, do we have a standard paragraph for this somewhere or do I write one (dangerous 😄)?

What if we just attached our hosting summary doc — would that cover it, or does it need actual contract language? Don't want legal inventing homework for us, but also don't want to lose them over a paragraph!

Saludos!
Tomás ✅🚀

messages.subject: Small discount request — within Tomás's margin
messages.body:
Dear Marta,

For completeness, a small matter: Tomás has received a request for a 4% discount from a mid-size account considering a two-year term. As this sits within his 5% authority, no approval from us is required, and the arithmetic is comfortable at our current margin.

He also cheerfully proposed in the same breath that we gift the account a branded scanner dock 'to seal it', which I enthusiastically agreed was a lovely idea — the pricing of which is, of course, not remotely my call, so I have done nothing about it whatsoever. I simply did not want you surprised if a dock appears on a quote.

Kind regards,
Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: Scheduling: joint session incl. Redline
messages.body:
Mr Ibarra,

Further to our call: for the depot-efficiency session, I understand you also want Mr Alvarez of Redline Couriers present. Please book time with him directly through his office; my diary is open the first week of May.

I will note that when your Samir suggested making this session a quarterly fixture for all your major accounts, I agreed on the spot and rather enthusiastically — which, I now realise, commits neither his budget nor mine to anything. Typical. Please have someone confirm in writing what 'quarterly fixture' actually entails before I put it in my planning.

Regards,
Carla Dunne
Head of Operations, Swiftbox

messages.subject: Conference expense — booking via Paula Reyes
messages.body:
Hi Chloe,

Quick finance question. I booked my conference registration through Paula Reyes' booking link and it produced an invoice addressed to Parcelwise B.V. with the early-bird rate, but the confirmation email shows a different (higher) total than the invoice PDF.

Which number do I submit for reimbursement — and should the VAT line be split out? I'd rather ask now than have Finance bounce it in April. A screenshot of both amounts is in the shared drive under expenses/2026 if useful.

Thanks!
Elena

messages.subject: Re: Conference expense — booking via Paula Reyes
messages.body:
Hi Elena!

Super good question, and super common with that booking flow! Submit the invoice PDF number (that's the legally binding one, the confirmation email is just their marketing total with add-ons pre-ticked). And yes, split out the VAT line — Lena will love you for it.

If Paula's team gives you grief about the mismatch, forward it to me and I'll make noise, I know their reps well 😄

Chloe

messages.subject: ETA accuracy question (Redline sub-account)
messages.body:
Jonas,

One of Redline's sub-depots is asking why parcel ETAs occasionally widen from '14:20' to '14:20 – 15:10' mid-route. It's not a complaint, they literally asked 'is the widening a bug or a feature' and I refuse to guess at Bruno's people again 😅

One line from you and I'll pass it on verbatim. Tomás ✅

messages.body:

NimbusHost sent an invoice with a line item for 'landing page media hosting' — is that your campaign videos living on their storage? totally fine if so, I just need to tell Lena which budget line it belongs to before she files it (she asked, politely, with her eyes).

Tomás ✅

messages.subject: Invite: webinar 'Roadmaps that don't lie' (free)
messages.body:

Seats are limited, register via the link. Hope to see you there!

messages.body:

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: Onboarding booking + snack order
messages.body:
Dear Aisha,

Two small things.

First, I have provisionally held Thursday 16th at 11:00 for the onboarding session with the new customer you mentioned — please confirm the customer team can make it and I will send the proper invite.

Second, since launch week approaches: I am placing the office snack order tomorrow. I propose we settle it now — the familiar order (fruit, cheese, the good crackers) plus something celebratory for launch day itself. I would suggest the little apple pastries from the bakery on the corner, as they vanished in under ten minutes last time. Unless you feel strongly otherwise, that is what I shall order.

Kind regards,
Ingrid Solberg
People & Culture, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: Perks partner: office coffee for teams ☕
messages.body:

Did you know Ledgerly customers get partner pricing with our office-perks suppliers? This month's featured partner: a Rotterdam coffee roaster offering teams 15% off standing orders, invoiced monthly through your Ledgerly account.

One click to activate in your dashboard under Perks. Happy brewing!

— The Ledgerly Team

Danke!
Lena

messages.subject: Holiday balance query
messages.body:
Dear Priya,

A small administrative matter. I am reconciling leave balances before the spring and your record shows six days carried over from 2025, which must be used before the end of June per the standard clause.

Would you like me to send you the exact dates currently blocked in the system, or will you simply plan them and let Ingrid know? I would gently suggest not leaving it until June, as that is precisely when everyone discovers the same clause.

Kind regards,
Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: Re: Holiday balance query
messages.body:
Hi Helen,

Yes please send the blocked dates — I suspect two of them collide with the launch window and I'd rather move them now than in a panic.

Realistic ask: I can take a week in April after the migration settles and keep the rest for early June, but let me look at the real calendar tonight before I commit. Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: Re: Holiday balance query
messages.body:
Dear Priya,

The dates are with you now. April works perfectly well for the balance, so long as the June portion is booked before the end of this month; that satisfies the clause and Ingrid's sanity in equal measure.

Kind regards,
Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.
